chunk: Maria Davila was born on March 2, 2002, in Kansas. Growing up in a family of scientists, Maria was exposed to the wonders of biology from a young age. She spent most of her childhood exploring the outdoors, developing a passion for surfing and scuba diving. Her parents, both marine biologists, encouraged her curiosity, and she began assisting them on research expeditions during her summer breaks.
